Detail-Rich Sound - Mic Mini delivers high-quality audio. A 300m max transmission range [2] ensures stable recording, even in bustling outdoor environments like a busy street.
Record Longer - Two transmitters and a mobile receiver offer a maximum operating time of 11.5 hours [5]. That's enough time for high-usage scenarios like interviews.
